title: Display the model fitting history
description: You plot the stored log likelihood values across iterations.

steps.description: You create a figure and plot model[ll_history]. Each stored value becomes one point in the plotted sequence.
You title the chart EM Log-Likelihood. EM names the expectation-maximization fitting procedure whose history the model stores.

steps.question: What quantity does the vertical axis show?
steps.answer: It shows log likelihood. The horizontal axis identifies iteration positions in the stored history.

steps.description: You label the axes and display the chart. The supplied output includes no numeric history values from which to describe its shape.
